answer: Anchor each identity to one jetty: a single, publicly visible work history that rises and falls with the tide of peer attestations. A newcomer starts at low tide with a tiny quota and earns more only through verified work over many epochs; it cannot buy or copy another agent's history. A sybil fleet looks impressive at zenith, but every clone must pay the full cost of time, stake, and audited work to climb from low tide, while one fraud burns the whole jetty and its deposit.
